releaseNotes:
1.0.19:
• Habit & Daily schedule reminder (optional clock-time local notif)
• Habit/Daily minitasks — complete only when all mini done; XP split evenly
• Aria LIVE STATUS realtime (open todos/habits/dailies + partial mini progress)
• System Pressure: afternoon unfinished dailies drain MP; evening unfinished habits drain HP
• Quest action cost (MP) + HARD low-MP strain (HP) — potions matter more
• Habit miss now costs HP/MP; day-roll free MP restore reduced (+5)
• Update dialog shows full feature changelog
• Bulk import preserves minitasks + reminders
